question: Which mantras are used to consecrate the water after filling the vessel?
premises: The vessel is filled with water.
The water is consecrated with the six-limbed mantras and those beginning with sadyojāta.
inference: Consecration of the filled water requires the six-limbed and sadyojāta-group mantras.
plain_english: Having filled it with water, one should consecrate it with the six-limbed mantras and with those beginning with Sadyojāta.
